abstract: We provide direct evidence on how the public expects the government to satisfy its intertemporal budget constraint. In a representative survey of U.S. households, respondents expect only 45% of government debt to be financed by future primary surpluses and 23% to be rolled over indefinitely without ever generating surpluses, as if sustained by a bubble. Experts perceive an even larger bubble (37%). Beliefs respond to fundamentals: at a debt-to-GDP ratio of 150%, the perceived bubble shrinks to 15%. A New Keynesian model calibrated to these beliefs implies a 13% larger government spending multiplier.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于公众如何预期政府满足其跨期预算约束的直接证据。在一项具有代表性的美国家庭调查中，受访者预期仅有45%的政府债务将由未来基本盈余融资，而23%的债务将被无限期滚动而不产生任何盈余，仿佛由泡沫支撑。专家感知到的泡沫更大（37%）。信念对基本面因素有所反应：当债务与GDP之比达到150%时，感知到的泡沫缩小至15%。一个根据这些信念校准的新凯恩斯模型显示，政府支出乘数将增加13%。
title: Perceived Budget Constraint of the Government

abstract: This paper constructs a new annual panel for 14 Western countries over 1800–2016, linking homicide to alcohol consumption (by beverage type), drug offenses, deterrence, and education. The central innovation is the first harmonized long-run cross-country alcohol series that can be aligned with the major historical waves in lethal violence. Across graphical evidence, narratives, and multivariate panel regressions, homicide co-moves strongly with alcohol, while education, deterrence, and demography capture the broader institutional context. We interpret the estimates as suggestive long-run relationships and use them for a multivariate historical accounting of the post-war crime wave and subsequent decline.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个覆盖14个西方国家、时间跨度为1800年至2016年的新型年度面板数据，将凶杀案与酒精消费（按饮料类型）、毒品犯罪、威慑力量及教育水平联系起来。核心创新在于首次建立了与致命暴力主要历史浪潮相吻合的、协调一致的长期跨国酒精消费序列。通过图形证据、叙事分析和多元面板回归，凶杀案与酒精消费呈现强相关性，而教育、威慑及人口结构则捕捉了更广泛的制度背景。我们将这些估计解读为提示性的长期关系，并利用它们对战后犯罪浪潮及其后续下降进行多元历史核算。
title: From spirits to crime: two centuries of alcohol and homicide in the West
title_zh: 从烈酒到犯罪：西方两个世纪的酒精与凶杀

abstract: A simple production economy with nominal price rigidities explains several key asset pricing facts, including the average slopes and cyclicality of equity and interest rate term structures. Nominal rigidities amplify the procyclicality of dividends after negative productivity shocks and generate countercyclical inflation, as sluggish price adjustment leads to a gradual dividend recovery. Consequently, short-duration equities (bonds) have more (less) procyclical payoffs than their long-duration counterparts. Slow-moving consumption habits produce large, countercyclical risk prices, yielding realistic asset valuations. Extending Campbell–Cochrane preferences with both market- and home-consumption habits allows them to operate in production economies while preserving realistic macroeconomic dynamics.
abstract_zh: 一个具有名义价格刚性的简单生产经济模型，能够解释若干关键资产定价事实，包括股票和利率期限结构的平均斜率及其周期性。名义刚性放大了负向生产率冲击后股息的前瞻性周期性，并产生反周期的通货膨胀，因为价格调整迟缓导致股息逐步恢复。因此，短久期股票（债券）的支付比长久期对应物更具（更不）前瞻性周期性。缓慢变动的消费习惯产生大规模、反周期的风险价格，从而得出符合现实的资产估值。将Campbell–Cochrane偏好扩展至同时包含市场消费习惯和家庭消费习惯，使其能在生产经济中运作，同时保持现实宏观经济动态。
title: A New Keynesian model of the term structures of equity and bond returns
title_zh: 股票与债券收益率期限结构的新凯恩斯模型

abstract: The current opioid epidemic is the worst drug epidemic the U.S. has ever faced. We examine the role of social connections in its spatial spread. Having many friendship links to counties with high opioid exposure positively correlates with overdose death rates. To address identification concerns, we exploit two quasi-natural experiments that led users to substitute illicit opioids for prescription drugs. Having more friends exposed to counties affected by these shocks leads to more overdose deaths. We also provide suggestive evidence that spillovers affect different stages of addiction, are influenced by both supply- and demand-side conditions, and are attenuated in counties with more cohesive local friendship networks. Our results show how social connections contribute to the spread of the opioid epidemic.
abstract_zh: 当前阿片类药物危机是美国历史上最严重的药物流行病。我们考察了社会联系在其空间传播中的作用。与阿片类药物暴露水平较高的县拥有众多友谊链接，与过量死亡率的上升呈正相关。为解决识别问题，我们利用了两个准自然实验，这些实验导致使用者从处方药转向非法阿片类药物。更多朋友暴露于受这些冲击影响的县，会导致更多过量死亡。我们还提供了初步证据表明，溢出效应影响成瘾的不同阶段，受供需双方条件的影响，并在地方友谊网络更为紧密的县中有所减弱。我们的研究结果表明，社会联系如何促进阿片类药物流行病的传播。
title: Friends with drugs: The role of social networks in the opioid epidemic
title_zh: 毒品之友：社交网络在阿片类药物流行中的作用

abstract: The European Union's AI Act – the world’s most ambitious regulatory framework for artificial intelligence to date – was supposed to enter into full effect on 2 August 2026. But while the AI Act's transparency layer has come into effect, obliging providers to inform individuals when they interact with an AI system, its high-risk regime – covering biometric identification, recruitment systems, credit scoring, law enforcement, and border control – has been delayed. This column argues that the result is a double bind in which Europe loses regulatory sovereignty whether it enforces its own rules or retreats from them.
abstract_zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》——迄今为止全球最具雄心的AI监管框架——原定于2026年8月2日全面生效。然而，尽管该法案的透明度条款已生效，要求提供商在个人与AI系统互动时告知对方，但其高风险制度——涵盖生物识别、招聘系统、信用评分、执法及边境管控——已被推迟。本专栏认为，其结果是一种双重困境：无论欧洲是执行自身规则还是退让回避，都将丧失监管主权。
title: Europe's regulatory double bind
